entries.title: OpenAI launches free 6-month ChatGPT Pro and Codex #openai #codexforopensource #aidevelopment
entries.summary: OpenAI launched a 'Codex for Open Source' program giving eligible maintainers of active public GitHub repositories six months of free ChatGPT Pro plus Codex access, valued at about $1,200. It targets code review, bug fixes and documentation tasks for the open-source developer community.

entries.title: Me walking out of my bedroom at 2AM to this
Why AI Jailbreaks Still Work in 2026 (ICML Demo)
entries.summary: Citing ICML 2026 research, the video explains that jailbreaks still work because models can't structurally distinguish developer instructions from user text and instead infer authority from writing style. The advice for agent builders: treat model guardrails as a hint, not a wall, and validate critical actions outside the model.

entries.title: AI Data Center Financing: NVIDIA's Massive $250B Deal Explained #shorts
entries.summary: Debt markets are reportedly hesitant to finance the roughly $250B needed for AI data centers, and NVIDIA may backstop OpenAI's loans to keep buildouts moving. The clip flags this as a circular-financing risk in the AI economy: NVIDIA financing purchases of its own chips.

entries.title: Claude exposes public Artifact indexing risk in Google Search #claudeai #privacy #aitechnology
entries.summary: Public Claude Artifacts (dashboards and mini-sites built in Claude) can get indexed by Google Search once shared publicly, unintentionally exposing private projects. It's described as a visibility-setting issue rather than an Anthropic security breach, so users should double-check sharing settings.

entries.title: OpenCode: The Open Source AI Coding Agent for Your Terminal (and Desktop)
entries.summary: OpenCode is an open-source (MIT) AI coding agent that runs in the terminal or a new beta desktop app, offering a read-only 'plan' agent for safe codebase exploration and a full-access 'build' agent, switchable with Tab, plus an '@general' subagent for complex searches. It has around 191.9k GitHub stars.

entries.title: Claude Can Edit Videos With this Skill 🔥🤯
entries.summary: The video demonstrates using Claude Code together with the open-source HyperFrames framework to edit videos through a chat interface with a live preview, applying requested changes without a traditional timeline editor.
